decision.explanation: The original sources provide direct and complementary evidence supporting three distinct affiliations of Bijesh Kumar Biswal. Document d1 confirms his affiliation with the National Institute of Technology, Rourkela, including a specific departmental affiliation (Mechanical Engineering) via a 2018 publication. Document d2 independently supports his work at the Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche (CNR). These are distinct organizations, and the Department of Mechanical Engineering at NIT Rourkela is a subset of the broader NIT Rourkela affiliation. All claims are directly sourced and do not conflict in referent.
